summary: To run an EE against a remote host you need a reachable host, credentials and a sudo user; create an inventory and playbook, then run ansible-navigator with -i, the image, and -u/-k/-K as needed.
questions: How do I run an EE playbook against a remote server?
How do I pass SSH and sudo passwords with ansible-navigator?
What do I need before running an EE on a remote target?

answer_card.title: Run an EE against a remote host
answer_card.answer_md:
Needs: a reachable IP or hostname, valid credentials, and a user with `sudo` on the target.
```bash
mkdir inventory   # add inventory/hosts.yml
ansible-navigator run test_remote.yml -i inventory \
  --execution-environment-image postgresql_ee:latest \
  --mode stdout --pull-policy missing --enable-prompts -u student -k -K
```
Replace `student` with your user; `-k`/`-K` (SSH and become password prompts) may be unnecessary depending on your auth.
